Three professional traders. Three completely different systems. Same 15 seconds.

Kevin Trudeau asked them to just tell him what to do, trading-wise. They told him he wouldn't actually follow it, so they proved the point instead: on the next Fed rate decision, each one called their trade out loud right before executing it.

One went long. One went short. The third didn't decide until ten seconds before. All three made six figures, in the same 15 seconds, doing the opposite of each other.

The method mattered less than actually having the conviction to execute it.

Which one would you have trusted?

#kevintrudeau #trading #investing #mindset #wealthmindset #discipline

Two railroads tried to extort John D. Rockefeller. They were the only way to move his kerosene, so they tripled the price, figuring he had no choice.

He went from a fortune to nearly broke overnight. Then he looked at his own refineries, realized oil moves through pipes, and built the first pipeline across America, cutting the railroads out. Profits went up 10x.

Years later the government broke up Standard Oil as a monopoly. Instead, his stock in the 36 companies it split into made him five times richer within a year.

His own words for it: every adversity is the seed of a greater benefit.

#kevintrudeau #wealthmindset #mindset #businesshistory #success #money

Kevin Trudeau is banned from blackjack in casinos worldwide. He's in the Griffin book - a list of players who count too well to let play.

So he switched games. He built his own algorithm for Baccarat, a game everyone said was pure coin-flip luck, and hit his daily number 100% of the time for eighteen straight months.

Then Steve Wynn called - not to ban him, to pay him a fortune to teach the system to Wynn's own gamblers.

Kevin asked why hand over a system that beats the house. Wynn's answer: give it time and they'll trust their gut over the system - and the house takes it all back.

A system only works if you actually stick to it.
